title: The Walk Back
description: Dunstan said he'd walk back in and ask Hesper for his name when he was done. Not before.

stages.text: The lantern from the end of the long walk has come halfway in and stopped. The boards are laid for going in, not for coming back. Go out to it.
Dunstan walked in behind your light and stands at the staithe's foot. He'll ask Hesper for his name himself; be there when he does.
